## RFI intake, AI acknowledgment and escalation

New RFIs are validated, logged to Airtable, acknowledged by email and announced on Discord. Urgent items escalate to Telegram and the engineer inbox.

## RFI answers

Answers are matched to the register by RFI ID, the record is marked answered, and the submitter is notified. Unmatched answers get an explanatory notice.

## Submittal packages

Submittals are validated, classified by a gpt-6-luna agent, logged to the submittal log, acknowledged by email and announced on Discord.

## Daily overdue sweep

Every weekday morning open RFIs and submittals are summarized, emailed and posted on Discord, with an all clear when nothing needs chasing.

## Track construction RFIs and submittals with Airtable, Gmail, Discord, Telegram and gpt-6-luna

### How it works

1. An RFI arrives on a webhook, is validated, and a gpt-6-luna agent drafts the acknowledgment.
2. The RFI is logged to Airtable, the submitter is emailed, and the team is notified on Discord.
3. Urgent RFIs are escalated to Discord, Telegram and the engineer's inbox.
4. Answers arrive on a webhook, are matched to the register by RFI ID, and the record is marked answered.
5. Submittal packages are validated and classified by a gpt-6-luna agent before being logged and acknowledged.
6. Every weekday morning a sweep emails and posts what is due or overdue, and sends an all clear when nothing is pending.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Connect your Airtable credential and select the RFI register, submittal log and project tables
- [ ] Connect OpenAI, Gmail, Discord and Telegram credentials
- [ ] Replace the placeholder Gmail recipients, Discord channel and Telegram chat with your own office contacts
- [ ] Copy the webhook URLs (rfi/intake, rfi/answer, submittal/intake) into your project forms or app
- [ ] Move the daily sweep schedule to your local morning

### Customization

Change the urgency thresholds, add more submittal disciplines, or swap Discord and Telegram for the channels your team already uses.
